title: Glycerol Stock Preparation
author: Alba Balletbó
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7uehnte

steps.title: Grow overnight culture
steps.instruction: Inoculate 5 mL to 10 mL of Luria‑Bertani (LB) medium (or alternative media such as M9 minimal medium or Terrific broth) with the desired strain and incubate overnight.

steps.title: Prepare glycerol stock mixture
steps.instruction: Transfer culture to a sterile cryogenic vial and add glycerol.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 700 µL of the overnight culture into a Corning® 2 mL Internal Threaded Polypropylene Cryogenic Vial (self‑standing with round bottom, Catalog #430488).
Add 300 µL of sterile 80 % (v/v) glycerol solution to the vial and invert the tube 2–3 times to mix.

steps.title: Freeze glycerol stock
steps.instruction: Place the prepared glycerol stock at –80 °C until needed.
